verses.original: ה֣וֹי שׁוֹדֵ֗ד וְאַתָּה֙ לֹ֣א שָׁד֔וּד וּבוֹגֵ֖ד וְלֹא־ בָ֣גְדוּ ב֑וֹ כַּהֲתִֽמְךָ֤ שׁוֹדֵד֙ תּוּשַּׁ֔ד כַּנְּלֹתְךָ֥ לִבְגֹּ֖ד יִבְגְּדוּ־ בָֽךְ׃ס
verses.transliteration: hō·w šō·w·ḏêḏ wə·’at·tāh lō šā·ḏūḏ ū·ḇō·w·ḡêḏ wə·lō- ḇā·ḡə·ḏū ḇōw ka·hă·ṯim·ḵā šō·w·ḏêḏ tūš·šaḏ kan·nə·lō·ṯə·ḵā liḇ·gōḏ yiḇ·gə·ḏū- ḇāḵ
verses.literal: Woe to you O destroyer never destroyed O traitor never betrayed When you have finished destroying you will be destroyed When you have finished betraying you will be betrayed
verses.literalPt: AI de ti, despojador, que não foste despojado, e que procedes perfidamente contra os que não procederam perfidamente contra ti! Acabando tu de despojar, serás despojado; e, acabando tu de tratar perfidamente, perfidamente te tratarão.

verses.original: יְהוָ֥ה חָנֵּ֖נוּ לְךָ֣ קִוִּ֑ינוּ הֱיֵ֤ה זְרֹעָם֙ לַבְּקָרִ֔ים אַף־ יְשׁוּעָתֵ֖נוּ בְּעֵ֥ת צָרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ḥān·nê·nū lə·ḵā qiw·wî·nū hĕ·yêh zə·rō·‘ām lab·bə·qā·rîm ’ap̄- yə·šū·‘ā·ṯê·nū bə·‘êṯ ṣā·rāh
verses.literal: O LORD be gracious to us We wait for You Be our strength every morning and our salvation in time of trouble
verses.literalPt: SENHOR, tem misericórdia de nós, por ti temos esperado; sê tu o nosso braço cada manhã, como também a nossa salvação no tempo da tribulação.

verses.original: מִקּ֣וֹל הָמ֔וֹן נָדְד֖וּ עַמִּ֑ים מֵר֣וֹמְמֻתֶ֔ךָ נָפְצ֖וּ גּוֹיִֽם׃
verses.transliteration: miq·qō·wl hā·mō·wn nā·ḏə·ḏū ‘am·mîm mê·rō·wm·mu·ṯe·ḵā nā·p̄ə·ṣū gō·w·yim
verses.literal: The peoples flee the thunder of Your voice the nations scatter when You rise
verses.literalPt: Ao ruído do tumulto fugirão os povos; à tua exaltação as nações serão dispersas.

verses.original: וְאֻסַּ֣ף שְׁלַלְכֶ֔ם אֹ֖סֶף הֶֽחָסִ֑יל כְּמַשַּׁ֥ק גֵּבִ֖ים שׁוֹקֵ֥ק בּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’us·sap̄ šə·lal·ḵem ’ō·sep̄ he·ḥā·sîl kə·maš·šaq gê·ḇîm šō·w·qêq bōw
verses.literal: Your spoil, O nations, is gathered as by locusts . . . like a swarm of locusts men sweep over it
verses.literalPt: Então ajuntar-se-á o vosso despojo como se ajunta a lagarta; como os gafanhotos saltam, assim ele saltará sobre eles.

verses.original: נִשְׂגָּ֣ב יְהוָ֔ה כִּ֥י שֹׁכֵ֖ן מָר֑וֹם מִלֵּ֣א צִיּ֔וֹן מִשְׁפָּ֖ט וּצְדָקָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: niś·gāḇ Yah·weh kî šō·ḵên mā·rō·wm mil·lê ṣî·yō·wn miš·pāṭ ū·ṣə·ḏā·qāh
verses.literal: The LORD is exalted for He dwells on high He has filled Zion with justice and righteousness
verses.literalPt: O SENHOR está exaltado, pois habita nas alturas; encheu a Sião de juízo e justiça.

verses.original: וְהָיָה֙ אֱמוּנַ֣ת עִתֶּ֔יךָ חֹ֥סֶן יְשׁוּעֹ֖ת חָכְמַ֣ת וָדָ֑עַת יִרְאַ֥ת יְהוָ֖ה הִ֥יא אוֹצָרֽוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ’ĕ·mū·naṯ ‘it·te·ḵā ḥō·sen yə·šū·‘ōṯ ḥā·ḵə·maṯ wā·ḏā·‘aṯ yir·’aṯ Yah·weh hî ’ō·w·ṣā·rōw
verses.literal: He will be the sure foundation for your times a storehouse of salvation wisdom and knowledge The fear of the LORD . . . is Zion’s treasure
verses.literalPt: E haverá estabilidade nos teus tempos, abundância de salvação, sabedoria e conhecimento; e o temor do SENHOR será o seu tesouro.

verses.original: הֵ֚ן אֶרְאֶלָּ֔ם צָעֲק֖וּ חֻ֑צָה מַלְאֲכֵ֣י שָׁל֔וֹם מַ֖ר יִבְכָּיֽוּן׃
verses.transliteration: hên ’er·’el·lām ṣā·‘ă·qū ḥu·ṣāh mal·’ă·ḵê šā·lō·wm mar yiḇ·kā·yūn
verses.literal: Behold their valiant ones cry aloud in the streets the envoys of peace weep bitterly
verses.literalPt: Eis que os seus embaixadores estão clamando de fora; e os mensageiros de paz estão chorando amargamente.

verses.original: נָשַׁ֣מּוּ מְסִלּ֔וֹת שָׁבַ֖ת עֹבֵ֣ר אֹ֑רַח הֵפֵ֤ר בְּרִית֙ מָאַ֣ס עָרִ֔ים לֹ֥א חָשַׁ֖ב אֱנֽוֹשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: nā·šam·mū mə·sil·lō·wṯ šā·ḇaṯ ‘ō·ḇêr ’ō·raḥ hê·p̄êr bə·rîṯ mā·’as ‘ā·rîm lō ḥā·šaḇ ’ĕ·nō·wōš
verses.literal: The highways are deserted travel . . . has ceased The treaty has been broken the witnesses are despised and human life is disregarded . . .
verses.literalPt: As estradas estão desoladas, cessou o que passava pela vereda, ele rompeu a aliança, desprezou as cidades, e já não faz caso dos homens.

verses.original: אָבַ֤ל אֻמְלְלָה֙ אָ֔רֶץ הֶחְפִּ֥יר לְבָנ֖וֹן קָמַ֑ל הָיָ֤ה הַשָּׁרוֹן֙ כָּֽעֲרָבָ֔ה וְנֹעֵ֥ר בָּשָׁ֖ן וְכַרְמֶֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·ḇal ’um·lə·lāh ’ā·reṣ heḥ·pîr lə·ḇā·nō·wn qā·mal hā·yāh haš·šā·rō·wn kā·‘ă·rā·ḇāh wə·nō·‘êr bā·šān wə·ḵar·mel
verses.literal: The land mourns and languishes Lebanon is ashamed and decayed Sharon is like a desert Bashan and Carmel shake off their leaves
verses.literalPt: A terra geme e pranteia, o Líbano se envergonha e se murcha; Sarom se tornou como um deserto; e Basã e Carmelo foram sacudidos.

verses.original: עַתָּ֥ה אָק֖וּם יֹאמַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה עַתָּה֙ אֵֽרוֹמָ֔ם עַתָּ֖ה אֶנָּשֵֽׂא׃
verses.transliteration: ‘at·tāh ’ā·qūm yō·mar Yah·weh ‘at·tāh ’ê·rō·w·mām ‘at·tāh ’en·nā·śê
verses.literal: Now I will arise says the LORD Now I will lift Myself up Now I will be exalted
verses.literalPt: Agora, pois, me levantarei, diz o SENHOR; agora me erguerei. Agora serei exaltado.

verses.original: תַּהֲר֥וּ חֲשַׁ֖שׁ תֵּ֣לְדוּ קַ֑שׁ רוּחֲכֶ֕ם אֵ֖שׁ תֹּאכַלְכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ta·hă·rū ḥă·šaš tê·lə·ḏū qaš rū·ḥă·ḵem ’êš tō·ḵal·ḵem
verses.literal: You conceive chaff you give birth to stubble Your breath is a fire that will consume you
verses.literalPt: Concebestes palha, dareis à luz restolho; e o vosso espírito vos devorará como o fogo.

verses.original: וְהָי֥וּ עַמִּ֖ים מִשְׂרְפ֣וֹת שִׂ֑יד קוֹצִ֥ים כְּסוּחִ֖ים בָּאֵ֥שׁ יִצַּֽתּוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yū ‘am·mîm miś·rə·p̄ō·wṯ śîḏ qō·w·ṣîm kə·sū·ḥîm bā·’êš yiṣ·ṣat·tū
verses.literal: The peoples will be burned to ashes like thorns cut down and set ablaze
verses.literalPt: E os povos serão como as queimas de cal; como espinhos cortados arderão no fogo.

verses.original: שִׁמְע֥וּ רְחוֹקִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֑יתִי וּדְע֥וּ קְרוֹבִ֖ים גְּבֻרָתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: šim·‘ū rə·ḥō·w·qîm ’ă·šer ‘ā·śî·ṯî ū·ḏə·‘ū qə·rō·w·ḇîm gə·ḇu·rā·ṯî
verses.literal: You who are far off hear what I have done you who are near acknowledge My might
verses.literalPt: Ouvi, vós os que estais longe, o que tenho feito; e vós que estais vizinhos, conhecei o meu poder.

verses.original: פָּחֲד֤וּ בְצִיּוֹן֙ חַטָּאִ֔ים אָחֲזָ֥ה רְעָדָ֖ה חֲנֵפִ֑ים מִ֣י׀ יָג֣וּר לָ֗נוּ אֵ֚שׁ אוֹכֵלָ֔ה מִי־ יָג֥וּר לָ֖נוּ מוֹקְדֵ֥י עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: pā·ḥă·ḏū ḇə·ṣî·yō·wn ḥaṭ·ṭā·’îm ’ā·ḥă·zāh rə·‘ā·ḏāh ḥă·nê·p̄îm mî yā·ḡūr lā·nū ’êš ’ō·w·ḵê·lāh mî- yā·ḡūr lā·nū mō·wq·ḏê ‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: The sinners in Zion are afraid trembling grips the ungodly Who of us can dwell with a consuming fire Who of us can dwell with everlasting flames
verses.literalPt: Os pecadores de Sião se assombraram, o tremor surpreendeu os hipócritas. Quem dentre nós habitará com o fogo consumidor? Quem dentre nós habitará com as labaredas eternas?

verses.original: הֹלֵ֣ךְ צְדָק֔וֹת וְדֹבֵ֖ר מֵֽישָׁרִ֑ים מֹאֵ֞ס בְּבֶ֣צַע מַעֲשַׁקּ֗וֹת נֹעֵ֤ר כַּפָּיו֙ מִתְּמֹ֣ךְ בַּשֹּׁ֔חַד אֹטֵ֤ם אָזְנוֹ֙ מִשְּׁמֹ֣עַ דָּמִ֔ים וְעֹצֵ֥ם עֵינָ֖יו מֵרְא֥וֹת בְּרָֽע׃
verses.transliteration: hō·lêḵ ṣə·ḏā·qō·wṯ wə·ḏō·ḇêr mê·šā·rîm mō·’ês bə·ḇe·ṣa‘ ma·‘ă·šaq·qō·wṯ nō·‘êr kap·pāw mit·tə·mōḵ baš·šō·ḥaḏ ’ō·ṭêm ’ā·zə·nōw miš·šə·mō·a‘ dā·mîm wə·‘ō·ṣêm ‘ê·nāw mê·rə·’ō·wṯ bə·rā‘
verses.literal: He who walks righteously and speaks with sincerity who refuses gain from extortion whose hand never takes a bribe who stops his ears against murderous plots and shuts his eyes tightly against evil
verses.literalPt: O que anda em justiça, e o que fala com retidão; o que rejeita o ganho da opressão, o que sacode das suas mãos todo o presente; o que tapa os seus ouvidos para não ouvir falar de derramamento de sangue e fecha os seus olhos para não ver o mal.

verses.original: ה֚וּא מְרוֹמִ֣ים יִשְׁכֹּ֔ן מְצָד֥וֹת סְלָעִ֖ים מִשְׂגַּבּ֑וֹ לַחְמ֣וֹ נִתָּ֔ן מֵימָ֖יו נֶאֱמָנִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: hū mə·rō·w·mîm yiš·kōn mə·ṣā·ḏō·wṯ sə·lā·‘îm miś·gab·bōw laḥ·mōw nit·tān mê·māw ne·’ĕ·mā·nîm
verses.literal: he will dwell on the heights the mountain fortress will be his refuge his food will be provided and his water assured
verses.literalPt: Este habitará nas alturas; as fortalezas das rochas serão o seu alto refúgio, o seu pão lhe será dado, as suas águas serão certas.

verses.original: מֶ֥לֶךְ בְּיָפְי֖וֹ תֶּחֱזֶ֣ינָה עֵינֶ֑יךָ תִּרְאֶ֖ינָה אֶ֥רֶץ מַרְחַקִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: me·leḵ bə·yā·p̄ə·yōw te·ḥĕ·ze·nāh ‘ê·ne·ḵā tir·’e·nāh ’e·reṣ mar·ḥaq·qîm
verses.literal: Your eyes will see the King in His beauty and behold a land that stretches afar
verses.literalPt: Os teus olhos verão o rei na sua formosura, e verão a terra que está longe.

verses.original: לִבְּךָ֖ יֶהְגֶּ֣ה אֵימָ֑ה אַיֵּ֤ה סֹפֵר֙ אַיֵּ֣ה שֹׁקֵ֔ל אַיֵּ֖ה סֹפֵ֥ר אֶת־ הַמִּגְדָּלִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: lib·bə·ḵā yeh·geh ’ê·māh ’ay·yêh sō·p̄êr ’ay·yêh šō·qêl ’ay·yêh sō·p̄êr ’eṯ- ham·miḡ·dā·lîm
verses.literal: Your mind will ponder the former terror Where is he who tallies Where is he who weighs Where is he who counts the towers
verses.literalPt: O teu coração considerará o assombro dizendo: Onde está o escrivão? Onde está o que pesou o tributo? Onde está o que conta as torres?

verses.original: אֶת־ עַ֥ם נוֹעָ֖ז לֹ֣א תִרְאֶ֑ה עַ֣ם עִמְקֵ֤י שָׂפָה֙ מִשְּׁמ֔וֹעַ נִלְעַ֥ג לָשׁ֖וֹן אֵ֥ין בִּינָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’eṯ- ‘am nō·w·‘āz lō ṯir·’eh ‘am ‘im·qê śā·p̄āh miš·šə·mō·w·a‘ nil·‘aḡ lā·šō·wn ’ên bî·nāh
verses.literal: You will no longer see the insolent . . . a people whose speech is unintelligible who stammer in a language you cannot understand
verses.literalPt: Não verás mais aquele povo atrevido, povo de fala obscura, que não se pode compreender e de língua tão estranha que não se pode entender.

verses.original: חֲזֵ֣ה צִיּ֔וֹן קִרְיַ֖ת מֽוֹעֲדֵ֑נוּ עֵינֶיךָ֩ תִרְאֶ֨ינָה יְרוּשָׁלִַ֜ם נָוֶ֣ה שַׁאֲנָ֗ן אֹ֤הֶל בַּל־ יִצְעָן֙ בַּל־ יִסַּ֤ע יְתֵֽדֹתָיו֙ לָנֶ֔צַח וְכָל־ חֲבָלָ֖יו בַּל־ יִנָּתֵֽקוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ḥă·zêh ṣî·yō·wn qir·yaṯ mō·w·‘ă·ḏê·nū ‘ê·ne·ḵā ṯir·’e·nāh yə·rū·šā·lim nā·weh ša·’ă·nān ’ō·hel bal- yiṣ·‘ān bal- yis·sa‘ yə·ṯê·ḏō·ṯāw lā·ne·ṣaḥ wə·ḵāl ḥă·ḇā·lāw bal- yin·nā·ṯê·qū
verses.literal: Look upon Zion the city of our appointed feasts Your eyes will see Jerusalem a peaceful pasture a tent that does not wander its tent pegs . . . will not be pulled up nor will any of its cords be broken
verses.literalPt: Olha para Sião, a cidade das nossas solenidades; os teus olhos verão a Jerusalém, habitação quieta, tenda que não será removida, cujas estacas nunca serão arrancadas e das suas cordas nenhuma se quebrará.

verses.original: כִּ֣י אִם־ שָׁ֞ם אַדִּ֤יר יְהוָה֙ לָ֔נוּ מְקוֹם־ נְהָרִ֥ים יְאֹרִ֖ים רַחֲבֵ֣י יָדָ֑יִם בַּל־ תֵּ֤לֶךְ בּוֹ֙ אֳנִי־ שַׁ֔יִט וְצִ֥י אַדִּ֖יר לֹ֥א יַעַבְרֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’im- šām ’ad·dîr Yah·weh lā·nū mə·qō·wm- nə·hā·rîm yə·’ō·rîm ra·ḥă·ḇê yā·ḏā·yim bal- tê·leḵ bōw ’o·nî- ša·yiṭ wə·ṣî ’ad·dîr lō ya·‘aḇ·ren·nū
verses.literal: But there the Majestic One our LORD will be for us a place of rivers and wide . . . canals where no galley with oars will row and no majestic vessel will pass
verses.literalPt: Mas ali o glorioso SENHOR será para nós um lugar de rios e correntes largas; barco nenhum de remo passará por ele, nem navio grande navegará por ele.

verses.original: כִּ֤י יְהוָה֙ שֹׁפְטֵ֔נוּ יְהוָ֖ה מְחֹקְקֵ֑נוּ יְהוָ֥ה מַלְכֵּ֖נוּ ה֥וּא יוֹשִׁיעֵֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî Yah·weh šō·p̄ə·ṭê·nū Yah·weh mə·ḥō·qə·qê·nū Yah·weh mal·kê·nū hū yō·wō·šî·‘ê·nū
verses.literal: For the LORD is our Judge the LORD is our lawgiver the LORD is our King It is He who will save us
verses.literalPt: Porque o SENHOR é o nosso Juiz; o SENHOR é o nosso legislador; o SENHOR é o nosso rei, ele nos salvará.

verses.original: נִטְּשׁ֖וּ חֲבָלָ֑יִךְ בַּל־ יְחַזְּק֤וּ כֵן־ תָּרְנָם֙ בַּל־ פָּ֣רְשׂוּ נֵ֔ס אָ֣ז חֻלַּ֤ק עַֽד־ שָׁלָל֙ מַרְבֶּ֔ה פִּסְחִ֖ים בָּ֥זְזוּ בַֽז׃
verses.transliteration: niṭ·ṭə·šū ḥă·ḇā·lā·yiḵ bal- yə·ḥaz·zə·qū ḵên- tā·rə·nām bal- pā·rə·śū nês ’āz ḥul·laq ‘aḏ- šā·lāl mar·beh pis·ḥîm bā·zə·zū ḇaz
verses.literal: Your ropes are slack they cannot secure the mast . . . or spread the sail Then an abundance of spoils will be divided and even the lame will carry off plunder . . .
verses.literalPt: As tuas cordas se afrouxaram; não puderam ter firme o seu mastro, e nem desfraldar a vela; então a presa de abundantes despojos se repartirá; e até os coxos dividirão a presa.

verses.original: וּבַל־ יֹאמַ֥ר שָׁכֵ֖ן חָלִ֑יתִי הָעָ֛ם הַיֹּשֵׁ֥ב בָּ֖הּ נְשֻׂ֥א עָוֺֽן׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇal- yō·mar šā·ḵên ḥā·lî·ṯî hā·‘ām hay·yō·šêḇ bāh nə·śu ‘ā·wōn
verses.literal: And no resident of Zion will say I am sick The people who dwell there will be forgiven of iniquity
verses.literalPt: E morador nenhum dirá: Enfermo estou; porque o povo que habitar nela será absolvido da iniqüidade.
